title: THANK YOU JESUS

lines.text: Thank you Lord for loving me.
Thank you Lord for loving me.
You rose up from the grave,
To me new life you gave,
Thank you Lord for loving me.

chords:
[Verse 1]
[D][G]Thank you [D]Jesus,
Thank you Jesus,

[Chorus]
Thank you [A]Lord for loving [D]me.
(Repeat)

[Verse 2]
[D]You went to Calvary,
[G]There you died for [D]me,

[Chorus]
Thank you Lord for loving me.
(Repeat)

[Verse 3]
[D]You rose up from the grave,
[G]To me new life you [D]gave,

[Chorus]
Thank you Lord for loving me.
(Repeat)
